description: Hourly WHOLESALE electricity prices for Lithuania (Nord Pool day-ahead, LT bidding zone) for today or tomorrow, in euro cents per kWh EXCLUDING VAT, by Europe/Vilnius hour, with the daily average and the cheapest and dearest hour. Useful for timing home charging on a dynamic tariff. Not a retail or public charging price. Tomorrow's prices are published around 14:00 Vilnius time. Ask resolution "15min" for the quarter-hour prices (96 a day since 2025-10-01), which show short dips the hourly average hides.

resolution.description: "15min" adds the quarter-hour prices as [HH:MM, ct/kWh] pairs and the cheapest and dearest quarter-hour. Default "hour".
